# Appchi context map

Candidate context only: matching does not establish completeness. Read applicable workspace/repository instructions, resolve scope corrections, inspect actual code and callers, and expand when new dependencies or uncertainty appear. Requirements outside the selected topics remain binding.

Pick an intent for what to do and topics for what to read, then run `python scripts/context.py plan --intent INTENT --topic TOPIC --content` from appchi-delivery. Required links are mandatory; related links say when to read more.

Open the workspace root as an Obsidian vault to include sibling repositories. Graph edges alone do not encode the conditions on each topic page.

## Intents

| Intent | For | Finish line |
|---|---|---|
| `question` | understand or answer | A cited answer separating specified, implemented, deferred and verified behavior; no edits. |
| `change` | add or modify | Checks ran on the final code, results and skipped checks are recorded, and affected documentation is current. |
| `review` | check a diff | Findings ranked by severity with failure scenarios, or a clear statement that none survived verification. |
| `investigate` | unexpected behavior | A diagnosis backed by reproduction or evidence; any fix follows the change intent. |
| `operate` | run, release, recover | The operation is done, or stopped at an authorization boundary, with revisions and results recorded. |

Unclear requests start as `question`.
